notes: A security day, spent testing the running app rather than reading it. GOAT's local server listens on your own PC, and any website open in your browser can send it requests that arrive looking local - verified against a running copy, a page on any site could switch on the other-device dashboard, start SMART, the overlay and the radar, and push your data to the cloud. Requests that change anything now have to come from GOAT's own page, and the server only answers to the address it serves. SMART tells you when he could not answer: a network blip used to leave him silent right after his own "Copy.", and he now says why in one short line, in English or Spanish. Talking over SMART stops the natural voice at once - the earlier barge-in fix had only reached the local voice, and the neural one kept playing to the end of its block. Signing out of your GOAT account on this PC now revokes the session on the server too, not just here. Other drivers' names - from a session, the community leaderboard or the drill board - are shown as plain text, never as markup.
